what: larch_quiet_init is not inert for the two new adopters
scenario_or_breakage: The plan tells run-step5-review.sh and run-step2-dispatch.sh to add larch_quiet_init while claiming no byte-shape change, but larch_quiet_init redirects ordinary stdout and stderr to a log by default. Usage, fail, and any existing printf or child output in those scripts can disappear from the caller-visible stream.
suggested_fix: Revise the plan to either source lib-quiet.sh without larch_quiet_init for these adopters, guard init behind the breadcrumb-monitor env, or convert all intended visible output to larch_err/emit and add explicit regression validation for the new stdout/stderr contract.

what: Done trap currently runs before the prior EXIT trap
scenario_or_breakage: The plan assumes appending after ci-wait.sh and collect-agent-results.sh traps yields writer or cleanup before the done sentinel, but larch_quiet__exit_combo writes LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL before evaling LARCH_QUIET_PREV_EXIT_TRAP. The foreground monitor can observe done and continue before ci-wait.sh writes its existing .done sidecar or before cleanup runs.
suggested_fix: Add scripts/lib-quiet.sh to the updated-file list and change larch_quiet__exit_combo to run the captured prior EXIT trap before larch_quiet__exit_write_done while preserving the original exit code, or otherwise implement a helper that truly appends the done sentinel last.

what: Breadcrumbs batch has no publishing callsite
scenario_or_breakage: The plan adds larch-log.sh support for a breadcrumbs batch, but design-log-publish.sh only stages top-level files and render-cache, and the implement Step 7a/refresh log flush snippets do not call larch-log.sh write for breadcrumbs. The new batch can pass unit checks yet never appear under committed larch-logs.
suggested_fix: Add explicit publisher updates for design and implement flows to call larch-log.sh write --batch breadcrumbs --input-dir "$TMPDIR/breadcrumbs" before the relevant commit/publish step, including no-directory and partial-failure handling.

scenario_or_breakage: The plan requires per-file streaming-redactor failures to append a Warnings entry, but append-tool-failure.sh requires --log and --output-file and larch-log.sh currently has no --input-dir parent/issue-log resolution in its write parser.
